### Observed differences

- In the later window, A02 is no longer observed at all: in the earlier window it appeared in about 49 of 100 traces (about one occurrence per trace on average), while in the later window none of the 200 traces contain it and it has no observed outgoing transitions. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- A03 and A14 became much rarer: each appeared in about 49 of 100 traces earlier and in about 19 of 100 later (mean occurrences per trace fell from 0.87 to 0.36 for both); when they do occur, they sit later in the trace (median event position about 0.36 to 0.55 for A03, about 0.44 to 0.63 for A14). [OCC002, OCC003, POS002, POS005]
- A10 grew in importance: traces containing it rose from about 24 to about 46 of 100, its median event position moved earlier (about 0.50 to 0.31), and A10-to-A10 repetitions within five steps rose from 16 to 42 supporting observations. [POS003, LAG007]
- Successor shares were widely redistributed away from A02 and A03: A15 now leads mostly to A10 (about 63 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) instead of A03 (about 60); A09 leads mostly to A10 (about 47) instead of A03 (about 35) and A14 (about 25); A14 now leads mostly to A13 (about 76, previously about 9); A13 lost its outgoing shares to A02 (about 34) and A03 (about 19) in favour of A09 (about 30), A08 (about 28) and A10 (about 20); A08 flipped from leading mostly to A10 (about 81) to leading mostly to A03 (about 69). [DIR011, DIR006, DIR010, DIR009, DIR005]
- Relations involving A02 collapsed to "partner only" or "neither": pairs such as A02–A09, A02–A07, A02–A10, A02–A13 and A02–A03 co-occurred in about 47–49 of 100 traces earlier and in none later, while the partners now appear without A02 (A09 in about 45 of 100 traces, A10 in about 46, A13 in about 46, A03 and A14 in about 19 each). [REL004, REL002, REL005, REL007, REL001, REL008]
- Pairings around A10 strengthened while old pairings weakened: A10 with A13 now co-occur in about 46 of 100 traces (previously 24), A09 with A10 in about 45 (previously 24), A07 with A10 in about 45 (previously 23); pairs among A03, A07, A09, A13 and A14 that co-occurred in about 47–49 of 100 traces now do so in about 18–19. [REL023, REL021, REL017, REL025, REL012, REL010]
- Distances between consecutive activities shifted accordingly: A13 followed by A03 within one step fell from about 38 of 100 observed pairs to none, and A03 followed by A09 now concentrates at distance three (about 79 of 100 observed pairs, previously spread over one to two steps). [LAG009, LAG002]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis of a participation and structure change: in the later window A02 is no longer executed, A03 and A14 have become optional (run in roughly one fifth of traces instead of one half), and A10 carries much more of the flow (about 46 of 100 traces, often repeated), with successor routing redirected from A02 and A03 toward A10, A13, A09 and A07. Because A02 is entirely absent later rather than merely less frequent, this is a case of an activity being removed or no longer triggered and others becoming optional — not a re-weighting of paths that all remain in use. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, POS003, REL004, DIR009, DIR010]

The supporting signs are direct and consistent: the participation drops are observed directly (0 of 200 later traces contain A02; A03 and A14 fall from about 97 to 37 supporting traces), the relation and redirection items agree with these changes across many activities, and the ensemble of 60 qualified control-flow items is roughly ninety times the number expected by chance (about 0.67), so random re-sampling of a stable process cannot explain the pattern as a whole. [OCC001, OCC002, REL001, DIR011, screening]

Limitations: zero participation only shows A02 was not observed in the later sample; the evidence cannot distinguish a genuine removal from the activity simply never being triggered in these 200 traces. The many lag and position shifts largely restate the same underlying trace changes, so they are agreeing rather than independent confirmations. [OCC001, LAG009, POS003]

Other differences: smaller redirections not part of the main hypothesis — A11's outgoing share to A03 fell (about 27 to 4 in 100) while A10 and A06 rose to about 22 each; A05's outgoing moved from A02 and A08 toward A13, A03, A09 and A14; and A11 tends to appear slightly earlier in the trace (median position about 0.50 to 0.35). [DIR008, DIR003, POS004]
